stem: As per area which of the following is the largest continent?
expl: There are a total of 7 continents in the world- Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia. Asia is the largest continent having an area of 44,568,500 sq. km. The area of other continents is as follows– Africa - 30,065,000 sq. km. North America - 24,473,000 sq. km. South America - 17,819,000 sq. km. Antarctica - 14,200,000 sq. km Europe - 9,948,000 sq. km. Australia - 7,741,220 sq. km.

stem: Which of the following countries is not located in the continent of Africa?
expl: Guyana is a country located in the continent of South America. Therefore Guyana is not located in the continent of Africa. The capital of Guyana is George Town. stem: Which one the following is the correct sequence of the given continents in the descending order of their percentage of Earth's land?
expl: According to Phillip’s Atlas, the percentage of the land area of the continent in respect of their total land area of the Earth is as follows – Asia - 29.8% Africa - 20.3% North America - 16.2% South America - 11.8% Antarctica - 9.2% Europe - 6.8% Australia - 5.9% Thus the descending order of continents given in the question in respect of their land area percentage is Africa – North America – South America – Europe.

stem: Which of the following countries is not located on the Continent of Africa?
expl: Gabon is a country located on the West coast of Central Africa. It is located on the equator. Its capital and largest city is Libreville. Guinea is a west coastal country in West Africa. Conakry is its largest city and also its capital. It is the world's 2nd largest producer of bauxite and has rich deposits of diamonds and gold. Guinea – Bissau is a country in West Africa. Bissau is its capital city. Guyana, officially the Cooperative Republic of Guyana is a country in the northern mainland of South America. Guyana is the only South American nation in which English is the official language.

stem: Which of the following is not associated with Australia Continent ?
expl: The Eyre Lake Basin, located in Australia (and also the world's largest), is the largest internal drainage system, covering an area of approximately 1.2 million square kilometers. In the middle of the basin lies Lake Eyre. The Nullarbor Plain is located on the southern coast of Australia. Mount Selwyn is located in Australia, while the Salween Valley is situated in the Arunachal Pradesh region of India.
